unsupported: The two longtime friends, both classically trained artists, founded the studio to design, build, and create work across disciplines with a specialization in concrete.
Their collaboration began from a shared artistic background and a desire to tackle new ideas through an experimental approach to construction.
Each piece is hand-built using casting, carving, and mold-making techniques, with an emphasis on one-of-a-kind, heirloom-quality results.
Past work includes museum pieces with carved concrete fossils and organic textures, and corporate sculptures for public spaces.
